messages:
Joel P.: FYI seeing a spike of user logins from our university partner where the SAML assertion is missing `eduPersonPrincipalName` (eppn) so JIT gives them the default `viewer` role instead of their mapped `researcher`/`admin` roles. Breaking role-based access for about a dozen users.
Maya R.: ugh. Any recent config changes in Okta mapping or the SAML app?
Joel P.: Not on our side. Okta logs show attribute absent. Example assertion dump from one failed case: ```<saml:Assertion ...> <saml:Attribute Name="eduPersonPrincipalName"></saml:Attribute> <saml:Attribute Name="email">user@uni.edu</saml:Attribute> </saml:Assertion>```
okta-alert-bot: alert: 12 failed/partial assertions in last 5m for app: redwood-prod-saml (see https://okta.example/alerts/ALRT-3942)
Ashley (IAM): Is our JIT provisioner treating missing eppn as auth failure or mapping to fallback role? We should fail closed.
Samir: Current behavior is fallback-to-viewer to avoid lockouts. That was an older safety decision. Given this is privilege regression in the other direction (loss of expected role) — we need a stricter policy.
Joel P.: Repro steps: 1) Have Okta send assertion without eppn 2) Login -> JIT creates user with `viewer` 3) Role mapping/rules don't trigger because mapping uses eppn OR group claim. We have a few legacy customers that rely only on eppn.
Maya R.: Short-term mitigation: change JIT to mark accounts created via incomplete assertions with `pending-role` and block sensitive ops until a role is confirmed. Can we push a toggle?
Ashley (IAM): I'll open a quick patch to change default to `pending-role` + emit audit log: `role_assignment:pending, reason:eppn_missing`. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/iam/merge_requests/872 (WIP).
oncall-bot: Pager triggered to iam-oncall
Samir: Also need to backfill affected users. Suggest query: `SELECT id FROM users WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-15' AND source='saml' AND role='viewer' AND metadata->>'saml_eppn' IS NULL;` We should rotate those to correct roles only after manual verification.
Joel P.: Audit trail: the role change events show `actor=jit-provisioner` and referenced S3 path `s3://redwood-audit/prod/2026/03/15/jit/xxx.json` encrypted with kms key `alias/redwood-audit`. Ashley, can you confirm KMS access for the team to decrypt for triage?
Ashley (IAM): I have access; will decrypt and post redacted assertions to #eng-security. Also adding a one-line migration script to tag these accounts with `saml:missing_eppn=true`.
Maya R.: Ops action: block any `admin`-level sensitive ops for accounts with `saml:missing_eppn=true` until manual verification. Samir can you add a transient policy?
Samir: On it. Will push an emergency policy: `deny if metadata.saml_missing_eppn == true AND requested_permission in (admin,manage_keys)` and deploy to prod in next 10m.
Joel P.: Thanks. Can we also ask the university IdP ops to start including `eduPersonPrincipalName` or an alternative mapped claim (e.g., `eduPersonTargetedID`) — I'll send the contact.
Ashley (IAM): Ticket opened with uni IT: TKT-1227. I'll post updates and schedule postmortem for Monday.
Maya R.: Good. After patch and backfill, we should add a unit/integration test asserting role mapping when eppn is present vs absent.
Joel P.: Agreed. Closing loop: urgent actions list -> (1) emergency deny policy (Samir) (2) PR to set pending-role + logs (Ashley) (3) KMS decrypt + triage (Ashley) (4) Backfill + manual verification (Samir/Ashley) (5) Contact uni IdP (Joel). I'll pin this thread. :thumbsup:
